topic.title: Oak
topic.teaser: Tree or shrub in the genus Quercus

easy.title: Oak
easy.line: Tree or shrub in the genus Quercus

easy.text: Ecologically, oaks are keystone species in habitats from Mediterranean semi-desert to subtropical rainforest.

medium.title: Oak
medium.line: Tree or shrub in the genus Quercus

medium.text: An oak is a hardwood tree or shrub in the genus Quercus of the beech family.
Individual oak trees of cultural significance include the Royal Oak in Britain, the Charter Oak in the United States.

deep.title: Oak
deep.line: Tree or shrub in the genus Quercus

deep.text: An oak is a hardwood tree or shrub in the genus Quercus of the beech family.
Individual oak trees of cultural significance include the Royal Oak in Britain, the Charter Oak in the United States, and the Guernica Oak in the Basque Country.
